item.title: Solved: How to Fix Model Item Type Mismatch Errors in MVC Views
item.description:
“Solved: How to Fix Model Item Type Mismatch Errors in MVC Views”

Q: What does the 'model item passed into the dictionary is of type X but this dictionary requires a model item of type Y' error mean

ANS: This error occurs when the data type of the model you are passing from your controller (or another view) to a view (or partial view) does not match the data type declared for that view. Essentially, the view is expecting one type of data (Y), but it’s receiving a different type (X). This often happens when using ViewDataDictionary implicitly or explicitly.
